svg.title: A sandwich-board sign
svg.desc: Two uniform boards are hinged together at the top and stand on the sidewalk as an upside-down V, their feet 1.10 m apart. The hinge is 1.30 m above the sidewalk. A horizontal chain joins the two boards 0.50 m below the hinge. Each board’s center of gravity, CG, is at its center. Drawn to scale. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Spreading the legs raises the chain tension
Each 4.00-kg half pivots about the hinge; the chain is fixed to the boards. Torque balance gives T ∝
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
